name: create-page
description: Creates a Notion page under a page, or a row in a database, with a title and optional plain-text content in which each line becomes a block: '# ' to '### ' headings, '- ' bulleted items, '[ ] ' and '[x] ' to-dos, any other line a paragraph, at most 100 lines of up to 200,000 characters each. Give exactly one parent: parentPageId, a page's id from notion__search-pages-and-databases, or dataSourceId, a data_source id from the same search. In a database, titleProperty names the title column (default Name) and properties takes Notion's own property values keyed by column name, which notion__query-database's rows show. Answers created and the new page's id and url.

parentPageId.description: The ID of the Notion page under which to create the page. Provide exactly one parent ID.

dataSourceId.description: The ID of the Notion data source in which to create the page. Provide exactly one parent ID.

titleProperty.description: For a data source page, the name of its title property. Defaults to Name.

content.description: Optional plain-text content. Each line becomes a block; #, ##, ###, -, [ ], and [x] prefixes select supported block types.

properties.description: Optional Notion property values to pass through when creating a page in a data source.
